trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops automatically. No multiplayer or DLC is needed.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks the moment the last one lands.
Every trophy is offline single-player, so no multiplayer or DLC is required.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 1.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 1; the trophy pops as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 2.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy pops as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 3.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 3; the trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 4.

steps.t: Complete Chapter 4; the trophy pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the final mission of the game.

steps.t: Complete the final story mission; the gold trophy pops with the end of the story.
After the story you can keep playing in free-roam — nothing is locked off.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run to the end.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist to the end.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play to the end.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners to the end.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown to the end.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.t: Play the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.
Automatic story trophy — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. It is far more forgiving than true 100% — closer to 60% of everything in the game.

steps.t: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist; progress made during the story already counts.

Work the checklist: 100 optional tasks, all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. Mix the four stunt types and pick the easiest ones.

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm; track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts.
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. Most happen naturally while playing.

steps.t: Do one of each of the 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; most unlock automatically from the story and map exploration.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the 12 ranges around Leonida.
All 42 gold medals are also required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total).

steps.t: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total.
All 42 drone time trials are also required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida.

steps.t: Win 20 different races — any of the 40 unique race locations count.
The 100% checklist needs 30 of 40 races won and 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge after he texts you.

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal), wait for Cal's text message marking a fishing location with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Go to the marked spot and beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games.

steps.t: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
You must finish all levels of the game once — beating every challenge is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline (Lucia only) in Chapter 3.

steps.t: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia; answer Andy's call, then follow her texts to Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The questline stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline (7 shipwrecks).

steps.t: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the Island Dreams mission he calls you and is marked KR in Key Lento.
Clear his 7 shipwreck treasure-diving quests — he marks purple chest icons on the map; use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor.
Track progress in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He is temporarily unavailable in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

steps.t: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
All his quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — many optional questlines do not.

steps.t: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy.
Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape quests, Kyle's McKittrick Farm quests, Yago's race quests and Pilot Pete's delivery quests.
All strands stay available in free-roam after the story; track your count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars.

steps.t: Randy's questline marks automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List, tracked under Map > Robberies; he marks some in fixed locations, others can be stolen off the street.
Deliver cars in good condition for more pay; he is marked RK in west Vice City. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline: shut down the Synthetic Labs (Jason only).

steps.t: Tyrone's questline marks automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason only); purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City.
Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then complete Spin On This to shut them down for good.
All of this stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is lost forever after Chapter 1 ends.

steps.t: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2.
MISSABLE — in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she will meditate, then walks to the balcony; follow her and choose Accept.
The Chapter 1 balcony meditation is lost permanently after Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway to be safe.
Track progress in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline (Jason only). He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle.

steps.t: Bret's questline marks automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason only).
Do Bret's quests and hunt the animals he requests; he gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle in the first quest.
Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck; all 15 Target Decks are also required for 100% completion.
PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets (480 cards in total).

steps.t: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets — 480 cards in total across the world.
Cards sit on indoor surfaces and in outdoor tool boxes and yellow phone boxes.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting after this pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app.

steps.t: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a location, then hold R1 to scan it.
Any 100 count — there are more than 100 scannable spots, including 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They build up naturally while working on other trophies.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
Track progress in Progress > Challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
Most complete naturally while working on other trophies — pick the easiest remaining ones to finish it off.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone.

steps.t: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) so the two of you are together.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape route.
It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while holding a wanted level.

steps.t: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: keep your partner with you and rob 3 shops back-to-back while holding a wanted level (red/blue flashing, not the red heat level).
Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop — hit a 4th if it doesn't pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app. You don't need to drive them.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan. You don't need to drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; the game has 557 vehicles at launch.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus use. Buff your focus first and pick a crowded gang fight.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff focus first with food, drinks, or Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it.
Line up 5 enemies and down all 5 in one use — an assault rifle like the Duke 556 helps. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang members at Gang Operations.
Focus levels up by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at Focus level 4 this is much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, then fly 1 km away.

steps.t: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes sitting on the airfield.
Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to enter, go upstairs to the cockpit.
Drive the plane back to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the trophy is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station.

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; tanks stand in the south of the base.
Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store silently with the Snap Gun, without triggering the alarm.

steps.t: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking and to mark jewelry store robberies.
Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun — don't kick the door, that triggers the alarm.
In the backroom, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm; the trophy pops shortly after leaving.
Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults. Bank vaults unlock through the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe) — it introduces bank vault robberies; you rob the first vault in the mission.

Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) — tail a van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag (hold Right to hand one off).
Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape; each robbery gives an instant 4-star wanted level, so use a fast motorcycle.
The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck. It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 bank vault mission.

steps.t: It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck.
Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, blow it open, then escape the red heat radius.
Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani unlocks as a fence in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is the fastest way.

steps.t: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida.
A plane is fastest — fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob 1 Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

steps.t: Rob 1 Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them.
Track per-gang progress in Progress > Gangs; the 100% checklist needs all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it. Note: KeenGamer still lists the exact trigger as unconfirmed — see the Disagreements section.

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, then drink it standing next to the bar.
Note: KeenGamer lists this trophy's exact trigger as still being confirmed — the PowerPyx method is the best report so far.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it through the window. Needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3. Note: KeenGamer still lists the method as unconfirmed.

steps.t: After unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City.
Steal the blue Banshee, drive forward straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops (slightly delayed) once you drive away — only this blue Banshee counts.
Note: KeenGamer lists this method as still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. You can grab them across multiple visits.

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation); it is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe.
Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway.
Escape the police — the trophy pops after escaping, not on pickup; if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise Strength to maximum for BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.t: Only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Raise Strength to maximum for BOTH Jason and Lucia — check in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
Work out together: buy a fitness club membership and always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle) — while one trains, the other completes training automatically.
Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It builds passively through robberies and fights.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so a demon face appears whenever an action counts.

It builds passively through robberies and fights; if you still need some at the end, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast — but note Psycho/Irredeemable profiles make cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no published guide has verified the method. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba. This guide will be updated when a method is confirmed.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — no published guide has verified the method. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner, in Little Cuba, Vice City.
Do not rely on unverified methods from forums or social media; this entry will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg at night in Kelly County. The spawn is slightly random. Note: KeenGamer lists this trophy as unconfirmed — see the Disagreements section.

steps.t: At night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car parked at the roadside.

If the car is there, follow the path into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it and it drops an abducted woman — talk to her and offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside.
The spawn is slightly random — if the car isn't there, drive away and come back. Note: KeenGamer lists this trophy as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Kick 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds. Note: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed.

steps.t: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
Crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best.
Note: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through a fence. It counts cumulatively across robberies.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver $250,000 total across all robberies (not at once); bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery but unlock only after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 total across all shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest since they cost the most.
Shop types: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 total. The 4 story garages don't count.

steps.t: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total); the 4 story garages don't count.
Garages unlock for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone.
Buy them through the phone app; robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to earn the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles.

Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click Respray then Register in his garage; initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers, later (Chapter 3) cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
